act_title: The Control of National Highways (Land and Traffic) Act, 2002
title: Limitation
text:
19. Limitation.—Every appeal to the [Court] under this Act shall be preferred within a period of

sixty days from the date on which the order appealed against has been made:

Provided that an appeal may be admitted after the expiry of the said period of sixty days, if the

appellant satisfies the [Court] that he had sufficient cause for not preferring the appeal within the
specified period.
